trigger: User production screenshot shows the six-subject editor becoming an unreadable wide matrix with column/subject misalignment.
principles: Follow the human entry order: exam context, overall result, each subject, notes.
Remove horizontal score tables and horizontal scrolling from exam entry.
Keep existing field names and API payload contract so stored data remains compatible.
Desktop uses two subject cards per row; narrow screens use one card per row.
Within a subject: score first, then class/school relative position.
Show converted-score input only when the scoring mode needs it.
Do not make missing rankings mandatory; incomplete data remains valid.
Preserve local IndexedDB draft recovery and existing submit/delete behavior.
